from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_to_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
